_note: Requests used by another Maccabi client, orenyomtov/maccabi-health (https://github.com/orenyomtov/maccabi-health, packages/core/src), that docs/endpoints.json does not list. Each was sent live on 2026-09-27 from a signed-in browser tab against one adult member's account, with that repo's method, body and query, one at a time, 300 ms apart. Nothing here is requested by this extension; it is a map of what else the site answers, so a future change can start from facts. No medical data: response shapes are field names and types, never values. Paths are relative to /sonline/<Service>/webapi/mac/ unless they start with /. {mid} = member id; the member id code is 0, as in endpoints.json.

conventions.checked: What the request returned on 2026-09-27. 'not checked' means the account had no row to build the request from, or the request was deliberately not sent (see the entry).
conventions.auth: Bearer = Authorization: Bearer <token> from the sign-in bootstrap below, as for every /sonline/ API call in endpoints.json. PDF routes answer without it, as in endpoints.json. Legacy /online/ routes use cookies only.
conventions.pdf_size: That repo caps every PDF at 2 MiB (PDF_BYTE_LIMIT) and rejects anything larger as INVALID_RESPONSE. The ordered medical file (letter_type 2 in endpoints.json) was 7.9 MB, so that client cannot download it.

session_and_account.checked: 200 JSON {token, current_customer_info, logged_customer_info, family_data, authorization_to_account, session_id}
session_and_account.notes: The sign-in bootstrap that repo starts every session with: token.content is the Bearer token, logged_customer_info the member's profile (names in Hebrew and English, birth_date, sex, age, phones, email, addresses), current_customer_info the member currently selected (a dependent when one is chosen in the portal), session_id the seed for the legacy sr_id, and current_customer_info.checksum_id the per-member secret the imaging handoff needs. It returns session credentials, so this extension must not call it (endpoints.json not_called_by_design); the extension reads the token from the tab's sessionStorage instead. When the session has ended it answers 200 text/html after a redirect to /my.logout.php3, not 401.

The portal's own keep-alive. That repo sends it every 240 s and found it keeps the server's idle clock from expiring, but it cannot extend the 3600 s absolute cap from sign-in (their docs/research/SESSION-LIFETIME.md). It does not re-arm the page's own 6-minute idle logout (endpoints.json auth.idle_logout): in this check, the session ended twice while a Maccabi page sat open in another tab with nobody using it, and held for a 4-minute run once no Maccabi page was open and this was sent every 60 s.

The site's feature flags. Two matter for downloads: isOpenPdfByLinkHandlerV2 (true: the site fetches a letter_type 2 file through MainAppAPI/v2/.../pdf, with a 202 first) and IshurMakdim (administrative case documents).
Who else is authorized to act on the account. With nobody authorized it answers a single warning message and users null. Grants and revocations exist on the site; this is only the read.

Opens the billing service; the requests below need it. Its select#PeriodSelectDropDownList lists the quarterly periods (16 in the account, back to 2015); #isUnderConstruction value 1 means the service is down. Decoded as UTF-8 the Hebrew came back as replacement characters: legacy /online/ pages are not UTF-8 (see findings.legacy_encoding).

legacy.request_body: {'value':'<period option value>'} (single-quoted, as the site's script sends it; Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8)
legacy.notes: The reports issued for one period. Rows are .dataGrid > .quaterly_table > .maintable > ul.rowgroup > li; the third span's link has onclick QuarterlyReport.OpenReportPdf('<token>', '<reportType>'). Row cells: period (e.g. רבעון שני 2026), production date (DD/MM/YYYY), link. The 16 'periods' are overlapping filters, not periods: 3 (last 3 years), 0 (all periods) and one per year. Every report is one quarter; the account had 44, Q3 2015 to Q2 2026, each listed under its year and some under the first two filters too. Filter 0 is paged: input#GridNumOfResultsHidden said 44 but it returned the first 12, so read it year by year. A report's link is the same under every filter it appears in.

The annual nursing-insurance (long-term care, 'Maccabi Siudi') reports: 8 in the account, 2011 to 2018. Links are LTCReport.OpenReportPdf('<token>', 'LTCReport'), written with HTML entities (' and  ) in the onclick attribute.

legacy.checked: 200 JSON {d: true}, then 200 application/pdf, for all 52 reports
legacy.notes: The first call stages the document; the PDF request fails without it. The query key is token for a quarterly report and Token for a nursing-insurance report. Quarterly report (1 page, about 60 KB, with a text layer): Maccabi's payments-and-credits notice for three months. It shows the recipient's name and postal address, the production date and the member number, then which plans each family member holds (Maccabi Sheli, Zahav or Kesef, nursing insurance, Keren Maccabi) with that month's dues and the last 4 digits of the charged bank account or card, a monthly summary by charge type (membership dues, quarterly co-payments, other charges and credits), and a per-month breakdown. Nursing-insurance report (1 page, 35 to 70 KB): the insurer's annual report for the policy year (Clal through 2018; from 2019-01-01 the insurer is Phoenix), with the policy's coverages, status, start and end dates, annual premium and the premium month by month. It prints each insured person's full name and ID number. Its text layer draws the header's phone and address digits with symbol glyphs, so extracted text is wrong there; the tables extract correctly.

The page behind hospital-stays in endpoints.json. It holds one #mailingsFromHospitalsController and a script with var pageSettings = {..., "YearsBack": "<1-99>"} (7 in the account). That repo sends GetMailingsFromHospitals {isDateSelected: false, fromDate: <DDMMYYYY number> - YearsBack, toDate: <DDMMYYYY number>}, subtracting the years from the day digits exactly as the site's controller does. That is the site's default window, the last YearsBack years, and it misses older stays: on 2026-09-27 it returned {ReportHospitalizations: [], ResultMessage: {Code: 0}} for an account whose 4 stays are all from 2001, which endpoints.json's explicit {isDateSelected: true, fromDate: '01011900', toDate: '31122099'} returned the day before. Ask for the full range.

findings.legacy_encoding: Every legacy response declares its charset, and it matches the bytes (checked 2026-09-27). The pages (/online/medicalfile/summary/, personalrecommendations/, directorship/debitsandcredits/) are text/html; charset=windows-1255, and so are the .asmx JSON services (PHR SearchByDate and GetFileDetails, GetAllPurchasedPrescription, the WcDebitsAndCreditsManager services): application/json; charset=windows-1255, with the Hebrew as raw single bytes, not \u escapes, so the bodies are not valid UTF-8. The /online/webapi/ service (GetMailingsFromHospitals) is application/json; charset=utf-8. fetch's .text() and .json() ignore the charset and always decode UTF-8, which is what turned the Hebrew into U+FFFD in this check. That repo reads legacy bodies with the Content-Type's charset, accepting utf-8 or windows-1255 and nothing else. Take the charset from Content-Type and decode the bytes with TextDecoder(charset, { fatal: true }), as this extension's Collector.legacyText does.
findings.session_end_shape: An ended session answered API and page requests with 200 text/html after a redirect to /my.logout.php3 (fetch follows it), not 401 or /my.policy. That repo's research saw a single 302 to /my.policy; a client should treat both as signed out.
findings.idle_logout_from_other_tabs: A Maccabi page left open in another tab signed the whole session out after a few minutes without mouse or keyboard input, even while this client's requests kept succeeding: the page's 6-minute idle logout (endpoints.json auth.idle_logout) ends the session for every tab. A 4-minute run held once no Maccabi page was open, the requests ran from a blank same-origin page, and the site's alive request was sent every 60 s.
